mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and generating positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods when FEDFUNDS declines, as measured by a t-test p-value > 0.05, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in both PAYEMS and a decline in UNRATE signals tightening labor market conditions, increasing corporate profit margins through wage stickiness and reduced turnover costs, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 100k in 1 month AND UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in < 40% of triggered instances, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in RSAFS above 490,000 million dollars, combined with rising HOUST, indicates strong consumer demand for housing and durable goods, which drives corporate revenue growth and positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive in triggered periods (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction signal has a Rank IC < 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.
